admission.deduplication: Authenticated owner and audio SHA-256. Retain the original metadata across retries.

transfer.body: Audio bytes with admitted MIME and exact Content-Length. The browser supplies Content-Length from the Blob.
transfer.result: A successful upload can return queued. Retain local audio until a matching status confirms transferred. Retry only after checking status; upload_state_unavailable leaves the outcome unknown.

authentication: Same-origin partner cookie and x-carr-csrf for POST/PUT, using private-session.js. Server scopes reads to the authenticated owner. A review link provides the session ID on another authorized device; there is no session-list endpoint.
review: Pending single-track candidates require explicit partner confirmation through existing resolve-post-call-candidate or resolve-candidate. Applied automatic changes and Undo use read-call-outcomes and undo-call-change. Those operations expose only unreviewed automatic changes and refuse human-confirmed changes. No transcript, Outlook draft creation, or automatic phone candidate application.
deployment_order: Depends on DoctorCRE/carr-system#2721 being merged and deployed. Do not enable auto-merge.
